name: Dr. S. Shekhar
qualification:
Graduate in Exploration Geophysics from Indian Institute of Science (IIT Kharagpur, 2008).
PhD in High P-T research fron BGI, Germany (2011).
15+ years of experience in mentoring JEE and NEET aspirants.
subjects: JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET - Physics & Chemistry
about:
Dr. Shekhar is the co-founder of Wizgyan. He is known for his unique teaching methodology that simplifies complex theoretical concepts into intuitive mental models. He has helped over 10,000 students achieve top ranks in competitive exams across India and abroad.

His philosophy is: 'Understanding why is more important than knowing what.'
